title: lasthenia glabrata subsp. coulteri
intro: Lasthenia glabrata subsp. coulteri, commonly known as Coulter's goldfields, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional herbal medicine, known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coulter's goldfields include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
